interpretation: A full-column-rank restriction outside a hyperplane proves no nonzero rational decoder column-space vector is supported inside it. All proper ternary frames lie inside some enumerated hyperplane. If all fail, a minimum-rank36 outer-product factorization cannot gather every center in a proper ternary frame. This does not exclude overcomplete factorizations with cancellations outside the decoder column space, a changed decoder, or other phase/label representations.
scope: Necessary obstruction for minimal scalar decoder factors, not universal theorem against ternary geometry.
